name: Mediocrity
overview: Scripture calls believers to reject mediocrity by embracing diligence, wisdom, and wholehearted devotion to God's Word. Meditating on Scripture day and night leads to prosperity and success, while laziness and slackness bring poverty. Christians are urged to be transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will, empowered through Christ to overcome worldly conformity and pursue excellence in all things.
